tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows only short-window positive gain. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish sustained gain from endogenous reversal and constrain the slow timescale before model confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-horizon model from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow adaptation relevant at H = 24.6.
More fine short-horizon observations would be less directly informative about long-horizon reversal.
It is not relevant to identifying the forecast mechanism.
